resources.string: The FileServer application allows you to share a directory on your smartphone. First, you select the directory you wish to share. This directory must not contain any sensitive information. Then, you activate your smartphone\'s Mobile Hotspot feature and launch the server. Devices connected to the smartphone\'s Mobile Hotspot will then be able to view files in the shared directory by accessing the URL indicated via the Status button. I understand that the FileServer application allows a directory I select to be made accessible to devices connected via Wi-Fi to my smartphone\'s Mobile Hotspot. I waive any liability against the publisher of this application in the event of undesirable consequences resulting from the use of this application.
